name: SH-5: thin-but-conclusive section still scores in full → conclusive

diagnoses.explanation: Conclusive support for DNS spoofing / poisoning: a decisive observation across 3 independent evidence groups (fit 97%, coverage 80%, margin 78%, contradiction 0%).

suppressed.detail: Observed with real support but below the reporting threshold; could not be confirmed or ruled out.

expected.explanation: Detected: DNS spoofing / poisoning. The evidence affirmatively supports this diagnosis.

why: M02/M09/M10 (quality floor): cage ran thin — inconclusive status, quality-attenuated observation — but a section that RAN and produced usable output must still contribute in full. The unusable-section guard may attenuate weight; it must never hide what a usable section measured. dnsSpoofing reaches Conclusive on real evidence, and the same thin-section observation is honestly admitted to contentTampering's overhang (belowTier) — the guard removes scoring, never the honesty overhang.
